as_of_note: US closes for Wed 28 Oct 2026, FOMC decision day: Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on a 10-2 vote (Cook and Hammack wanted a 25bp hike); Warsh would not prejudge December. S&P 500 +0.28% to 7,743.98, Nasdaq +0.27%, Dow +0.19%, Russell 2000 +0.41%; third straight gain. MU +5.9%, ORCL ~+11-12% on FY2030 $225B revenue outlook; NVDA -1.2%. 10Y 5.044% (+5.2bp), 2Y 4.731% (-0.4bp), 30Y 5.360%; DXY 102.13 (-0.25%); WTI $102.78 (+$2.88) on a WSJ report of a possible short US campaign against Iran after the midterms; spot gold $4,067.29 (+0.17%). After hours: GOOGL -7 to -9% (EPS/revenue miss, FCF -$9.07B), MSFT +2-4% (Azure +48%, capex $45.2B below est.), NOW -15%, FTNT -25%, CMG +5%; IREN ~-3%. Evening futures: Nasdaq 100 -1.2%, S&P -0.5%, Dow flat.

But two hawkish dissents, the 10Y back above 5%, oil up on Iran-strike reports and Alphabet's after-hours miss (Nasdaq 100 futures -1.2%) point to a softer open.

themes.title: Hawkish hold
themes.explanation: Fed held 3.75-4.00% 10-2 with Cook and Hammack for a hike; statement upgraded growth to "strong". Warsh would not prejudge December; 2Y slipped to 4.731% while 10Y rose 5bp to 5.044%, steepening the curve.
